thread:
maya (Partnerships): Heads-up: SereinCloud sent final collateral for the joint solution brief. Need UX-friendly thumbnails, one approved quote from their VP Eng, and a localized Spanish title for EU marketplace regions. Drive: https://drive.google.com/serein-assets :wave:

sam (Marketing): Got it. Do we have permission to use the VP Eng quote verbatim? They wrote: "Switching to Redwood cut our inference cost by ~38% and stabilized p99 latency." That might be too metric-specific for marketplace copy.

tess (Design): I can do mobile and desktop thumbnails. Request: please ask Serein for SVG lockup and the flat color variant. Gradients break on small sizes.

maya (Partnerships): Serein confirmed via email they can provide SVG + flat variant. They did note their logo has strict clearspace rules; I uploaded their `Serein_brand_guidelines_2025.pdf` to the folder.

ron (Legal): We need a signed usage consent if we publish the quote. Also run the quote for accuracy with their comms team. If they insist on metric details, add a citation note or switch to a qualitative line.

serein-design-bot: New files uploaded by @serein.design: `serein-lockup.svg`, `serein-lockup-flat.svg`, `serein-quote-approval-email.pdf` (private).

sam (Marketing): Thanks. Suggest rewording to marketplace-friendly sentence: "SereinCloud and Redwood reduced inference costs and improved latency stability for our models." Less numbers, more evergreen. Thoughts?

tess (Design): Works for thumbnails. For alt text we should keep it short: `SereinCloud and Redwood joint solution for inference`. Marketplace alt limit is 100 chars. Also exporting `240x240` and `1200x628` variants in figma.

maya (Partnerships): For localization: Serein provided a Spanish title suggestion: "Solución conjunta SereinCloud y Redwood para inferencia". Can Marketing QA? Link: `marketing/serein/localization` in Drive.

sam (Marketing): I'll run a quick QA and flag any awkward phrasing. We usually prefer "Solución conjunta de SereinCloud y Redwood para inferencia" — slightly more natural in ES-ES. Will confirm with Serein translation contact.

ron (Legal): Also add brand attribution footer in the solution brief PDF: "All trademarks belong to their respective owners." Confirmed. Make sure the PDF accessibility tags are preserved when we export.

marketplace-bot: Draft created: `serein-redwood-solution-brief`  review required by marketing and legal before publish.

tess (Design): Uploaded thumbnails + export spec to `marketing/serein/figma` (file `thumbs_export_v1`). I left a comment about color contrast on the 16x9 overlay — the Serein green needs +4.5:1 on the white token.

maya (Partnerships): Noted. If the contrast fails, ask Serein for a darker flat color. I already pinged them.

sam (Marketing): Checklist I'm creating in Drive root: `1) SVG lockup 2) Approved quote email 3) Localized titles 4) Alt text 5) Legal footer + accessibility tags 6) Final PDF export`. Tagging everyone. Targeting publication next Wednesday during the marketplace window.

ron (Legal): Fine, but keep the quote approval email attached to the listing audit record. If translation changes meaning, require a new signoff.

maya (Partnerships): Serein replied: they approve the marketing-friendly quote and will provide a stamped approval by EOD. They also uploaded a darker flat color `serein-flat-dark.svg`.

marketplace-bot: Reminder scheduled: review due in 48 hours for `serein-redwood-solution-brief`. (automated)

tess (Design): All updated assets pulled, exporting final set now. Will post final links here when done.

sam (Marketing): Great — once final assets + signed quote are in Drive I will request final sign-off and then submit for publish. :thumbsup:
